live2026_10_06.evidence: Read-only crawl of the owner-approved signed-in session by RealBud dev tooling: GET navigation to menu pages and DOM reads only. Nothing clicked, typed, saved or sent. UI labels only; no rows, field values, names, office zones/categories, account codes or query strings.

chrome.topBar: first top-level generic: link 'REI Cloud v <version> P' (UI version), then a list whose first button is the business code (account marker {landmark: list, role: button}); no banner or contentinfo landmark
chrome.sidebar: list of menu links; groups (Receipts, Process, Settings, Tools, My Profile, Communities) expand in place

grids.syncfusion: Record lists (Owners, Rentals, Tenants, Suppliers, Contacts, Sales, Listings, Agents, Pool of Owners) are Syncfusion grids: no pager; the footer says 'N records - M row(s) selected'. The first 90 rows render; more load only when the grid itself scrolls. A read is complete only when rendered rows == N (Suppliers 60/60 complete on first read; Tenants first read 90 of 106). Keyboard keys do not load more rows. Column menu (⋮) holds Autofit, Sort, Columns, Filter only: no export.
grids.datatables: Process, Receipts and Tasks screens are DataTables: 'Search:' box, 'Show entries' select, Previous / page numbers / Next pager; column headers read '<name>: activate to sort column …'.

live2026_10_06.listActionMenu: Every record list has an 'Action' dropdown (top right, beside 'Add New'). Opening it changes nothing. Its items are Send (Email/SMS/Letter/Form/Mail Merge/Invite to Portal), Record change (Apply Automation, Re-Assign …, Room Feature …, Delete Statement Message, Sync to Outlook, Complete/Retry Task(s)) or reports (Statement, Ledger, Task Reports). There is no Export item on any list.

reports.layout: Category tables of report links; a report link opens a hidden Bootstrap parameter modal (#reportParameterOwnerList_popup for most, #reportParameterRange_popup for range reports, #adminReportParameter_popup for Admin) loaded by data attributes (data-telerikname = the Telerik .trdp report).

output.rule: Export Only, never an Email option

parameterModal.note: Preview opens the Telerik viewer; its export formats were not opened on 6 Oct (next live look).

bulkReceipting.note: The File Format button shows the office's bank format; Austin's is ANZ CSV.
